questions.stem: What is the main purpose of using the same width for bars in a bar graph?
choices: To make the graph more visually appealing
To compare the heights of the bars accurately
To make the bars look wider
To represent different categories
questions.solution: The main purpose of using the same width for bars in a bar graph is to compare the heights of the bars accurately. This ensures that the visual representation reflects the actual data without distortion. The other options are incorrect because they either misinterpret the purpose or suggest misleading practices.

questions.stem: What does the term 'frequency distribution table' refer to?
choices: A table that shows the total number of items
A table that shows the number of times each item occurs

questions.stem: If a bar graph has a scale where 1 unit length represents 4 tickets, and the bar for Vidisha is 6 unit lengths, how many tickets were sold for Vidisha?

questions.stem: If a pictograph uses the symbol to represent 5 students, how many symbols are needed to show 25 students?
questions.solution: If 1 symbol represents 5 students, then 25 students would need 25 ÷ 5 = 5 symbols. The other options are incorrect because they do not match the calculation based on the given scale.

questions.stem: In the frequency distribution table of wickets taken by Jaspreet Bumrah, if 3 matches had 4 wickets each, how many total wickets were taken in these matches?

hi.stem: जसप्रीत बुमराह द्वारा लिए गए विकेटों के बारंबारता बंटन सारणी में, यदि 3 मैचों में प्रत्येक मैच में 4 विकेट लिए गए, तो इन मैचों में कुल कितने विकेट लिए गए?

questions.stem: Why is a bar graph with vertical bars more appropriate for representing the heights of mountains?
choices: Because it is easier to draw
Because it is easier to compare the heights of the bars
Because it is more intuitive and suggestive to represent heights upwards from the ground
Because it saves space on the graph
questions.solution: The correct option is because it is more intuitive and suggestive to represent heights upwards from the ground, as vertical bars naturally align with the concept of height increasing in an upward direction. Other options, like ease of drawing or saving space, are not related to the fundamental purpose of accurately representing height. Comparing heights is a result of the visual alignment, not the primary reason for using vertical bars.

hi.solution: सही विकल्प यह है कि ऊंचाई के प्रतिनिधित्व के लिए ऊपर की ओर जाना अधिक स्वाभाविक और संकेतात्मक है, क्योंकि ऊर्ध्वाधर बार ऊंचाई के बढ़ने के अवधारणा के साथ प्राकृतिक रूप से संरेखित होते हैं। अन्य विकल्प, जैसे बनाने में आसानी या स्थान बचाना, ऊंचाई के सही प्रतिनिधित्व के मूल उद्देश्य से संबंधित नहीं हैं। ऊंचाई की तुलना दृश्य संरेखण का परिणाम है, न कि ऊर्ध्वाधर बार के उपयोग का मुख्य कारण।
